prg_mapping: MMC3 PRG bank $1E is mapped at CPU $C000-$DFFF for these spans; PRG bank data begins after the 16-byte iNES header.

normal_nmi_call.source_condition: Normal NMI route; the source selects it when $001B.6 is clear.

secondary_queue_caller_gate.behavior: LDA $0498; BEQ $C951. A nonzero primary transfer count takes the primary-queue path and does not enter the secondary consumer.

primary_queue_consumer.queue_count: $0498 is decremented before indexing; X resolves to 3 * (old count - 1) for supported counts.
primary_queue_consumer.pointer_load: The record pointer is copied to zero-page $77/$78. A negative pointer high byte takes the mapper-switch path at $C91B.
primary_queue_consumer.runtime_consumer_scope: The Godot source-byte consumer supports observed nonnegative pointers into CPU RAM and up to four queue records in $0499-$04A4. Bank-switched pointers fail closed.

secondary_queue_consumer.ready_check: LDA $0515; BPL $C981; bit 7 clear returns without transfer.
secondary_queue_consumer.ready_clear: LDX #$00; STX $0515 before reading the first packet byte.
packet_format: length byte at $04A5,X; zero terminates the packet list
secondary_queue_consumer.ppu_state_effects: The component emits the source bus events. PPUSTATUS latch behavior, PPUADDR interpretation, PPUDATA increment, nametable mirroring, and memory effects remain with the caller-owned PPU model.

entries.role: The $0498 gate and the complete $C951 secondary-queue consumer, including the intervening primary-queue path.
Normal NMI path JSR $C8FB call site; the caller's path selection is separately source-owned.
